draft.emotion: bustling and lively, smelling of fresh food and noisy with vendors
notes: Spelled with a leading ต-, which acts as an unwritten leading syllable /tà-/ before ล-. A traditional fresh food market is often called ตลาดสด, while a night or flea market is ตลาดนัด.
